Replacements keep every otherwise-orphaned identifier referenced so each mutant COMPILES and dies on BEHAVIOR - a compile error is not a kill. W17M5 relies on `served` staying used via the &served rewind accumulator and the compound-assignment sites. The consult's R-C mutant '(ii) restore the early-return bypass' is NOT in this spec: the consult itself records the bypass as behaviorally identical for the witness-less posture at the current arm count, so a 'kill' would be theater; the two killable adjacent shapes (W17M3 reset, W17M4 guard deletion) are speced instead and the structural law is enforced by the seam comment + report disclosure.

Reverting to the wave-14 shape (caught-up leaves the armed lease untouched) restores the frozen-neighbour capture: every subsequent Step probes the frozen peer, returns caught-up forever, the cursor freezes while the healthy incumbent is never revisited.

On wall, (a) a five-times-faster third endpoint behind a hung neighbour is judged 'no faster' forever (finding 3 half one), (b) an adopted endpoint inherits a slow landing from the neighbour's hang (half two), and (c) slow store commits arm the lease although no endpoint is at fault (finding 4 - store time enters via wall, never via sigma).
